summary.text: Matt Bierlein is a Republican state representative from Michigan House of Representatives District 97 and the Republican candidate for Michigan State Senate District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Tuscola County commissioner, he is not seeking re-election to the House.

paragraphs.text: Matt Bierlein, listed by Ballotpedia as Matthew Bierlein, lives in Vassar, Michigan, and graduated from Vassar High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in organizational management from Spring Arbor University.
His career experience includes co-owning a physical therapy practice.
Bierlein served on the Tuscola County Commission, as president of the Michigan Association of Counties, and on the board of directors of the National Association of County Officers.

In the House, his 2025 and 2026 assignments are the Health Policy Committee, the House Oversight Committee, where he is majority vice chair, and the Select Committee on Protecting Michigan Employees and Small Businesses.
